launches.title: Oasive: Find better bonds to buy
launches.tagline: See which bonds are rich or cheap and decide what to buy
launches.body:
**TL;DR: [Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai)** **helps bond investors find better bonds to buy. Compare investments and test trade ideas in minutes with proprietary models and a team of AI analysts.**

<https://youtu.be/HlMWxuHhlo8>

Hi, I'm Anaïs, founder of [Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai). I worked on Wells Fargo's $350B mortgage-backed securities (MBS) portfolio, then as a portfolio manager on Google Treasury's $17B MBS/ABS portfolio, before leading product strategy across Google's consumer AI products.

I'm building [Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai) to help more fixed income investors find value and act on it.

**The problem**

Finding an attractive trade is only the start. Is it really cheap, what could change that, and does it improve the portfolio? Answering those questions means going back and forth between research, market data, models and spreadsheets.

**What we built**

[Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai) helps you uncover opportunities you might otherwise miss, compare investments and test the risks before putting on a trade. Macro and Rates Research and our MBS Platform are live today:

* **Macro and Rates Research:** Which Treasury maturities look cheap, and is there a curve trade worth putting on? Use our proprietary valuation models to compare maturities, curve trades and butterflies. Check how many Fed cuts are priced in, dig into market moves and economic releases, and keep exploring with unlimited chats and follow-ups.
* **MBS Platform:** Which MBS pools look attractive, and why? Use proprietary prepayment models and collateral analysis to spot relative value and test investment ideas. If rates fall 1%, what happens to your portfolio? Change rate and prepayment assumptions to see the impact on spreads, duration and value across your holdings.

_Municipals, ABS, and corporates are next._

[Oasive](http://www.oasive.ai) is already used across 15+ institutional desks at global banks, asset managers with $100B+ in AUM, and Fortune 500 treasury teams.

**Try it**

Start your Macro and Rates Research free trial or request an MBS demo at <https://oasive.ai/join> — free and paid plans available.

**Our ask**

Know portfolio managers, traders or analysts on fixed-income desks? I’d love an introduction. Email [anais@oasive.ai](mailto:anais@oasive.ai)
